reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.srSummary: Rated {score} out of 5 on Google, from more than 2,000 reviews across three lounges.

items.name: Maria Kampouri
items.quote: Amazing PCs, WiFi, and equipment. We took the duo private area and it was an amazing experience — gaming, eating, and relaxing in our own space. The service is amazing and the people here are polite. I will come again.

items.name: Alisher Bolatbek
items.quote: It was the best cyber lounge I have ever been. The PCs are really cool and the internet is fast. The music in the reception is nice. I surely recommend this place if you want to relax with friends and play some games.

items.name: Jvachka Chanel
items.quote: A wonderful bootcamp experience. This club provides an unforgettable experience. The service staff is top notch. Also pleasantly surprised by the cinema room. Excellent Dolby Atmos sound and noise isolation provides great emotions.

items.name: Alex Sawchuk
items.quote: I visited this place with my friend. Computers, mice, and keyboards are incredible. PlayStation with a cinema room is a great option for a large company. The service was incredible.

items.name: barmaley
items.quote: Prime Lounge Mokotów feels like a perfect setup — smooth like a high-end PC running without any lag. Clean vibe, great service, and everything just works. Hookah quality is on point too. Definitely coming back.

items.name: Vitalii Frantsishko
items.quote: The wholesome experience starting from atmosphere, service, quality to simply prices. Highly recommend.

club.q: How do I activate the club?
club.a: Open SENET and enter club code “{clubCode}”. New guests get the first hour free.

book.q: How do I book a PC or a room?
book.a: A PC is pay on arrival. Book a room or a PlayStation with the administrator, in the SENET ID app, or at <booking>prime.booking.enes.tech</booking>.

hours.a: Open every day, {hours}, at every lounge. We are not open 24/7. The club can open earlier or stay open longer if you arrange it with the administrator by phone.

prices.a: PC prices depend on the lounge. Private rooms, the cinema hall, and PlayStation are priced on their own. Ask the administrator.

deals.a: New guests get the first hour free. Birthdays get {birthdayAmount} {currency} on the PC balance when you show ID that your birthday is today. Students get {studentRate} off with a valid student card.

pay.q: Where are you, and how do I pay?
pay.a: Waliców 11, Rzymowskiego 53 in Mokotów, and Plac Teatralny 6–8 in Wrocław. Card, BLIK, or cash.
